We're smaller, more maneuverable.|Jacen|I doubt they'll give up because of a navigation hazard.|Jaina|No, but we can hope they crash.|attr=M-TD, Lobacca's translator droid, Jaina, and Jacen, discussing how to escape the Bartokk assassins|src=<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
The '''Dragon's Teeth''' was a natural formation of jagged rocks located in an [[Unidentified Hapan ocean|ocean]] near [[Reef Fortress Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|205|Dragon's Teeth}}</ref> In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Ta'a Chume]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainees [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], [[Lowbacca]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], along with Lobacca's [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] [[M-TD]], were in a [[Boat/Legends|boat]] being chased by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who were hired to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Ta'a Chume. Jaina, who was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the craft, decided to try to make the assassins crash by leading them into the Dragon's Teeth. Although the assassins did not crash, their craft did sustain some damage and three Bartokks fell out of it. The remaining Bartokks were eventually killed by some [[carnivorous seaweed]] which Jaina lured them into.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dragon's Teeth first appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', a young reader's novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] and published in [[1998]]. Later, it was given an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].
